basic_info.description: On a quiet, tree-lined block in Mission Terrace, this upgraded 1920s stucco home combines classic charm with modern updates. The light-filled living room with bay windows and original fireplace opens to a formal dining room with double-inlay hardwood floors. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers quartz counters, maple cabinetry, Heath tile backsplash, stainless appliances (Bosch dishwasher, Thermador hood, built-in oven, side-by-side fridge), and a sunny breakfast area leading to a large deck and landscaped garden. Two bright bedrooms and a remodeled skylit bath complete the main level.    The lower level provides versatility with a family room, en-suite bedroom, laundry, and generous storage/workshop. Restored carriage doors open to the garden, which doubles as a private parking pad; three off-street spaces total. Additional improvements include a new foundation with seismic upgrades, double-pane windows, updated electrical, recessed lighting, and forced-air heating.    Close to Glen Park and Balboa Park BART, freeways, cafes and restaurants, this home offers indoor-outdoor living in a safe, stable neighborhood with enduring community pride.
